card.name: Verbs leading up to the word disease
card.fires_on: The word 'cause' (or 'of'/'to' in 'development of', 'contribute to') right after a bacterium or toxin, where the next word is likely 'disease' or 'illness'.

modes.label: Pathogen causes illness
modes.description: The verb 'cause' follows a named bacterium and is expected to be followed by disease or illness.
modes.example: survive in people, and<< cause>> illness.

modes.label: Contribute to development of
modes.description: Linking words in 'contribute to the development of' before a disease name.
modes.example: which contribute to the development<< of>> CDAD.

card.writes: It promotes disease and illness words as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence about a germ is about to name the disease it causes.
